preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 4 and 5000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n and 3n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(degree(v) <= 3 for v in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The degree of every vertex is at most 3.
Every edge belongs to a cycle of length at most 5.

postconditions.expression: len(initial_bees) == 3 and all(1 <= b <= n for b in initial_bees)
postconditions.description: The first output consists of exactly three valid vertex indices representing the initial bee positions.

postconditions.expression: initial_nastya != initial_bees[0] and initial_nastya != initial_bees[1] and initial_nastya != initial_bees[2]
postconditions.description: The initial position of Nastya (received from stdin) is distinct from all initial bee positions.

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_move(prev_bees, curr_bees, edges) for prev_bees, curr_bees in zip(all_bee_states, all_bee_states[1:]))
postconditions.description: Every subsequent bee move output consists of three vertices where each bee either stays or moves to an adjacent vertex.

postconditions.expression: any(b in bees_state for bees_state, nastya_pos in zip(all_bee_states, all_nastya_positions) for b in bees_state)
postconditions.description: The game terminates when at least one bee occupies the same vertex as Nastya at any point (either after bees move or after Nastya moves).
The total number of moves performed does not exceed n.
